CHAP1ER-N

FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES OF PRIVATE PLACEMENT AGENCIES
The Private Placement Agency shall furnish the details of employment of
Domestic Worker to the Controiling Authority within seven days from the
date the woman was conveyed beyond the boundaries of State of Chhattisgarh.

· (2)

No Private Placement Agency shall charge any fee by whatever name called
from any domestic worker.

(3)

No Private Placement Agency shall employ, engage or deploy any woman, if
she is below eighteen years of age.

(4)

Every Private Placement Agency shall display signboard outside its office
showing the name of Private Placement Agency and its Licence number.

(5)

Every Private Placement Agency shall maintain a register containing the
names and addresses of domestic workers, who are engaged by it and also
names and addresses of persons, where the women workers have been employed.

(6)

Other functions and duties of Private Placement Agencies shall be such, as
may be prescribed.
